notes.title: Added chapter selection function - The Method of Hiding a Body
notes.content:
1. This game has now added chapter selection function, players can now select chapters in the main interface to play.
2. Added the option to adjust the Camera Shake Amplitude in the game Settings menu.
3. Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: Add checkpoint (Save point) function Version 2.00
notes.content:
1. The game has now added a checkpoint function, when the player plays a non-final ending, he can restart from the previous checkpoint, instead of starting the whole round again.
2. A dimly-lit scene adds brightness
3. Camera's shaking amplitude is changed to 70%
4. Added more guidance.
5. Fixed some bugs.
